description: This file implements a process manager in Go, providing functionalities to start, stop, and monitor system processes. It maintains a map of running processes and interacts with them via os/exec, handling process creation, termination, and status checks.

classes.name: DefaultProcessManager
classes.description: Default implementation of a process manager that can start, stop, and monitor system processes. Uses a map to track active processes.

methods.name: NewProcessManager
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a new instance of DefaultProcessManager with an initialized process tracking map.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts a new process based on provided configuration, sets up environment, working directory, and log redirection, then tracks the process and returns its PID.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops a process given its PID, first attempting graceful termination and then forceful if needed, and cleans up process tracking.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Retrieves current status and information of a process given its PID, indicating whether it is running or stopped.
